hotspots.label: Shingle surface
hotspots.description: The outer shingle layer forms the roof’s visible weather-shedding surface.

hotspots.label: Roof sheathing
hotspots.description: Sheathing creates a continuous deck beneath the roof covering.

hotspots.label: Roof framing
hotspots.description: Timber framing gives the roof its shape and structural support.

hotspots.label: Gutter system
hotspots.description: Gutters collect roof runoff and direct it toward downspouts.

hotspots.label: Adjustable louvers
hotspots.description: Rotating roof louvers control sunlight and overhead coverage.

hotspots.label: Integrated gutter
hotspots.description: The perimeter channel collects water from the pergola roof.

hotspots.label: Drainage post
hotspots.description: A concealed passage carries collected roof water through the post.

hotspots.label: Concrete footing
hotspots.description: The below-ground footing anchors the pergola’s support column.

hotspots.label: Water heater
hotspots.description: The storage heater holds heated water for household use.

hotspots.label: Water supply
hotspots.description: Separate hot and cold supply lines distribute water to fixtures.

hotspots.label: Drain network
hotspots.description: Larger drain pipes carry used water away from household fixtures.

hotspots.label: Bathroom fixtures
hotspots.description: Fixtures are the visible points where occupants use the plumbing system.

hotspots.label: Outdoor heat pump
hotspots.description: The outdoor unit exchanges heat with the surrounding air.

hotspots.label: Air handler
hotspots.description: The indoor air handler moves conditioned air through the home.

hotspots.label: Duct network
hotspots.description: Ducts distribute air between the central equipment and rooms.

hotspots.label: Room register
hotspots.description: Registers connect room air to the duct system.

hotspots.label: Breaker panel
hotspots.description: The panel distributes electricity across individual protected circuits.

hotspots.label: Branch circuits
hotspots.description: Wiring carries electricity from the panel to outlets and fixtures.

hotspots.label: Lighting
hotspots.description: Light fixtures turn electrical power into useful illumination.

hotspots.label: EV charger
hotspots.description: The exterior charging unit supplies power to an electric vehicle.

hotspots.label: Irrigation
hotspots.description: Irrigation brings water to planted areas through a controlled distribution system.

hotspots.label: Root zone
hotspots.description: The soil beneath the lawn supports roots and holds moisture.

hotspots.label: Subsurface drainage
hotspots.description: A gravel bed and perforated pipe provide a path for excess ground water.

hotspots.label: Hardscape
hotspots.description: Stone paving creates durable walking and gathering surfaces.

hotspots.label: Wall framing
hotspots.description: Timber studs form the supporting framework behind finished walls.

hotspots.label: Insulation
hotspots.description: Insulation within wall cavities slows heat transfer through the enclosure.

hotspots.label: Foundation
hotspots.description: The concrete foundation supports the house and transfers its loads to the ground.

hotspots.label: Interior finishes
hotspots.description: Flooring and finished walls define the surfaces people see and use.
